purpose: Prevent held-out tuning of operational target/nuisance decision boundaries and explicitly calibrate the field nuisance measurement into effect-specific nuisance evidence.

field_nuisance_mapping_required.input: FieldNuisanceProcessMeasurement plus development-only nuisance truth/effect labels
field_nuisance_mapping_required.rule: The three positive nuisance-effect risks must be calibrated or otherwise frozen independently enough that one uncalibrated scalar is not silently reused as all three effects.

target_boundary_required.direct_input_scale: PolliPi ordinal-v14-reference frozen by the target field adapter

hard_rules: final target_high, target_low and nuisance_high must be frozen before held-out scoring
no threshold may be chosen from held-out outcomes
field nuisance process index is not a calibrated probability by itself
claim thresholds are separate from observer decision thresholds
O thresholds/calibration remain a separate readiness item
development_inputs_allowed: development-only coupled field measurements once implemented
freeze_output_required: final nuisance effect-risk mapping or frozen deterministic equivalent
SHA-256 of the final calibration artifact
claim_boundary: Until frozen, V15-v2 may develop adapters and calibration procedures but must not run held-out operational T/C/N decisions using the development defaults as if they were field-validated thresholds.
